questions.q: What is the primary nutritional concern for a teenage pregnancy compared to an adult pregnancy?
options: Competition for nutrients between the growing adolescent mother and the fetus
Decreased need for calories due to smaller body size
Excessive weight gain is never a concern
questions.explain: Pregnant teens are often still growing themselves. They have higher nutrient requirements to support both their own growth spurts and fetal development, leading to nutrient competition.
